_meta.description: Spellblade subclass passives: 3 stat-based (max 20 levels each). Focus: hybrid ATK/MAG, melee survivability, attack speed.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente l'ATK de 0.5% et la MAG de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases ATK by 0.5% and MAG by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente l'armure de 0.8% et la resistance magique de 0.8% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases armor by 0.8% and magic resist by 0.8% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la vitesse d'attaque de 0.8% et la chance de double attaque de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases attack speed by 0.8% and double attack chance by 0.5% per level.
